description: Search or list leads (companies/accounts in Close) using Close's query language. Returns a `data` array of leads (with id, display_name, contacts, status, custom fields) plus `has_more` and `total_results`. The `query` param accepts Close search syntax, e.g. `name:"Acme"`, `status_label:"Potential"`, `email_address:@example.com`, `lead_created_within:7d`, or free text. Omit `query` to list all leads. Page with `_limit` (max 200) and `_skip`.

_skip.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0)

query.description: Close query string. Examples: `name:"Acme Inc"`, `status_label:"Potential"`, `email_address:@acme.com`, `lead_created_within:30d`. Free text also works. Omit to list all leads.

name: close_search_leads
title: Close Search Leads
